app.name: FarmSight
app.tagline: Check a buyer's offer before you sell

shell.descriptor: South Punjab · Your crop, your decision
shell.note: Prices are AMIS mandi reports. Estimates, old prices and limits are labelled on every screen.

data.syntheticNote: These numbers are not real. They are for testing only.
data.unchanged: AMIS has shown the same price since {{date}}, so treat it with care
data.weatherLine: Weather this week: {{tmax}}°C high, {{rain}} mm rain

select.quantityTooLarge: Quantity can be at most {{max}} maund

signal.impactFor: If you wait {{weeks}} weeks, on your {{qty}} maund
signal.baseline: Price estimate: today's price, with the range of past 4-week swings. Our model did not predict prices better than this, so we show this simple estimate.
signal.disclaimer: This is an estimate, not a guarantee.

direction.UP: Our model: the price is likely to rise in the next 4 weeks.
direction.DOWN: Our model: the price is likely to fall in the next 4 weeks.
direction.accuracy: (It called {{pct}}% of the big moves in 2025 right. Not a price forecast.)
direction.upButSell: The price may rise, but probably not by more than the interest of waiting, so the advice is to sell.

offer.title: Check a buyer's offer
offer.label: The buyer offered (Rs per maund, 40 kg)
offer.grossBasis: The offer is treated as the buyer's gross quoted price per maund, before any commission you pay.
offer.reportedDays: AMIS reported a price on {{days}} of the last {{window}} days.

vsReference.below: Your offer is {{diff}} per maund below the latest reported price.
vsReference.above: Your offer is {{diff}} per maund above the latest reported price.
vsReference.equal: Your offer equals the latest reported price.

offer.totalFor: Difference on your {{qty}} maund, compared with the latest reported price
offer.totalVsRange: Compared with the nearest edge of the recent range: {{total}}

limited.LIMITED_SAME_PRICE: AMIS reported the same reference price on all {{days}} reported days.
limited.LIMITED_STALE: The latest reported price is from {{date}}, more than 8 weeks ago.
limited.LIMITED_FROZEN: AMIS has shown the same price since {{date}}, which often means it was not updated.
limited.LIMITED_FEW_DAYS: AMIS reported a price on only {{days}} of the last {{window}} days.

limitedOffer.below: The offer is {{diff}} below that reported reference, but FarmSight cannot treat this as a reliable market range.
limitedOffer.above: The offer is {{diff}} above that reported reference, but FarmSight cannot treat this as a reliable market range.
limitedOffer.equal: The offer equals that reported reference, but FarmSight cannot treat this as a reliable market range.

offer.commission: Commission at the rate you entered ({{pct}}%): about {{perMaund}} per maund, {{total}} on your quantity. Your own estimate; not used in the comparison above.

nextSteps.title: Before you decide
nextSteps.askReason: Ask the buyer how the price was set, and whether quality or grade changed it.
nextSteps.reference: You can use these reported prices as an independent reference when you negotiate.
nextSteps.constraints: If you are tied by credit, transport or an urgent need for cash, FarmSight cannot remove that constraint.

alternatives.higherNotBetter: higher mandi price, but not estimated better after transport

assumptions.title: Not included, and assumptions
assumptions.QUALITY_GRADE_NOT_INCLUDED: Crop quality, grade and moisture are not included; they can change the price you are offered.
assumptions.BUYER_TERMS_NOT_INCLUDED: Buyer terms (when you are paid, deductions, credit) are not included.
assumptions.TRANSPORT_IS_ESTIMATE: Transport costs are estimates from road distance, not quotes.

offer.referenceOnly: These are reported mandi prices: a reference for negotiation, not a promise of what you will get. Timing, transport, credit and the actual auction can change the price you receive.

form.example: Example: wheat · Bahawalpur · {{qty}} maund · {{offer}} (fills the form only)

errors.offer: Enter the buyer's price per maund: a number above 0.
errors.tooLarge: That price is too large. Enter the price per maund (40 kg).

offer.loading: Checking the offer against the available reference…
offer.offerToRef: Buyer's offer → reported reference · difference on {{qty}} maund: {{total}}
offer.limitedExplain: FarmSight shows the numbers but does not judge the offer from this reference.
offer.checkYourself: Find out the crop grade, payment terms and whether a buyer is there yourself. FarmSight does not know them.

whatYouCanDo.title: What can you do now?
whatYouCanDo.body: Decide with a fresher reference, or with information straight from the mandi.

outlook.title: Market outlook
outlook.note: The price estimate and our model's signal, as background. Our forecasts were tested and are not reliable enough to tell you to hold your crop.
outlook.context: This is context, not a guaranteed future price. To decide on an offer, use the offer check.
outlook.whyLink: Why this outlook, and how good is the data?
outlook.estimateTitle: Price estimate for the next {{weeks}} weeks
outlook.ruleSays: The simple rule (wait only if the estimate beats interest and a 5% margin) says:

why.title: Why this advice
why.sourceFacts: Reasons from the data. Model explanations will replace these when the model is ready.

compare.title: Compare mandis after transport
compare.caution: This is not necessarily the best mandi. Check that a buyer is there and arrange transport before you travel.
compare.cautionWeak: Some prices here are limited (old, repeated or too few reports), so they are not ranked as better.
compare.orderOffer: Your mandi first, then the others. Not a ranking.
compare.orderNet: By estimated net price. A mandi is marked best only on a strong reference.
compare.vsOffer: Estimated difference from the buyer's offer on {{qty}} maund
compare.transportNote: Transport is an estimate from road distance, not a quote.

limitedNote.LIMITED_STALE: This price is old: it is not used to call this mandi better.
limitedNote.LIMITED_FROZEN: AMIS has not updated this price for weeks: it is not used to call this mandi better.
limitedNote.LIMITED_FEW_DAYS: Too few reports lately: this price is not used to call this mandi better.
limitedNote.LIMITED_SAME_PRICE: The same price on every reported day: not used to call this mandi better.

compare.bestStrong: Highest estimated net price, on a strong reference

calc.title: How is this calculated?
calc.net: Estimated net = reported reference − estimated transport, per maund
calc.difference: Difference = (estimated net − buyer's offer) × your maund
calc.notIncluded: Other fees, grade deductions and payment terms are not included.

compare.addOffer: Check an offer to compare with it
compare.footnote: The estimated net is not a promise of what you will be paid.

grow.title: What to grow: expected profit at harvest
grow.basedOn: Based on the mandi price of {{month}}: {{price}}
grow.years: Based on {{n}} years of AMIS prices
grow.bestSell: Best month to sell: {{month}} (usually {{gain}}% after interest)
grow.sellAtHarvest: Best to sell at harvest ({{month}}): holding usually does not beat the interest
grow.noBestSell: Not enough years of prices to pick a selling month
grow.notAvailable: No price data at this mandi for: {{crops}}
grow.estimateNote: Estimate: today's price times how prices usually move until harvest, minus the official cost of production. Not a guarantee.
grow.landInvalid: Enter your land in acres, above 0

history.title: Price history
history.seasonalNote: Each month as a % of the yearly trend (median across years). Above 100 is usually a better month to sell.

margin.title: What you keep from the price
margin.costNote: Cost of production: Punjab official tables, updated for inflation ({{confidence}}).

chat.title: Ask about your crop
chat.placeholder: For example: will the wheat price go up next month?
chat.fallback: This answer comes from our template, not the AI.
chat.tooLong: Please keep the question under {{max}} characters

profile.title: Your profile
profile.guest: You are using FarmSight as a guest.
profile.login: Log in with your phone number
profile.name: Name
profile.notFound: No profile with this number. Create one below.
profile.exists: This number already has a profile. Log in instead.
profile.alertsHelp: Alerts are off until you turn them on. At most one a week, and never for an old or frozen price.
profile.alertsNeedProfile: Price alerts need a profile. Log in or register first.
profile.alertsNotPromise: Alerts are information, not a promise of a sale or a price.

status.errorHint: Check your connection and try again.
status.replay: Replaying {{date}}: prices and advice as the app would have shown them that day. Weather and chat are today's.
status.notFound: No price data for this crop at this mandi.
status.invalid: Some of the details you entered are not valid. Please check them.

home.title: Got a buyer's offer? Check it before you sell.
home.subtitle: See the recent mandi reference and other mandis after transport, then decide for yourself.
home.trust: AMIS mandi reports · Urdu · WhatsApp menu (SMS not live yet)

freshness.title: How fresh is the data?
freshness.strong: Reference strength: strong enough to compare an offer with.
freshness.limited: Reference strength: limited. Use it with care, not as a firm range.

how.title: How FarmSight helps
how.reference: Compare it with the reported reference

last.title: Your last check
last.sessionOnly: Kept in this browser session only.
last.emptyBody: Enter a buyer's price above to see the recent reference, the difference for your quantity and other mandis.

cannotKnow.title: What FarmSight cannot know
cannotKnow.intro: These can change what you actually get for your crop:
cannotKnow.truck: Whether a truck is available, and its real fare
cannotKnow.credit: Credit you owe, or an urgent need for cash
cannotKnow.buyer: Whether a buyer is really there

details.strongHeadline: Recent and varied reports: usable as a reference
details.strongExplain: Still a reference, not a promise: grade, terms and the auction can change your price.
details.limitedExplain: An old, repeated or thin price does not show today's market, so FarmSight does not judge offers from it.
details.seeHistory: See the price history and dates

channels.title: FarmSight on WhatsApp and SMS
channels.subtitle: Low on internet? Check an offer with the numbered text menu.
channels.realText: The menu exactly as FarmSight sends it
channels.smsParts: {{parts}} SMS part(s). Warnings are never cut to save space.
channels.notAPromise: reported price, not a sale promise
channels.checkOfferFirst: Check an offer on the home screen to see the SMS FarmSight would send for it.
channels.menuWorks: The numbered text menu works the same on WhatsApp and SMS: no smartphone app needed for SMS.
channels.waConnected: This server is connected to WhatsApp.
channels.waNotConnected: WhatsApp is not connected on this server yet (it needs the Meta app keys).
channels.smsNotLive: SMS is not live yet: no SMS provider is connected. The menu above is what it will send.
channels.voiceOn: Voice notes are on, and always confirmed before any answer.
channels.voiceOff: Voice notes are not available yet. Type, or use the numbers.
channels.freeText: You can also type a whole query, e.g. "gandum bahawalpur 100 man offer 3514".
